power_telemetry_logger: smoothen out NaN values if possible This change adds a thin wrapper around numpy.interp to interpolate missing power data. It also introduces the policy that any array with a higher ratio than X where X is set to 0.1 will cause the power test to fail as this is likely a bigger issue than some one-off readings failing. Additionally, if there are more than Y, where Y is set to 5, consecutive NaN readings, the test will also fail. Lastly, it adds unit-tests for the data interpolation logic. arc: network: Recognize usb%d devices as ethernet When tethering to a Chrome OS device over usb, the network device shows up as usb%d which happen to be ignored by DeviceManager in arc-networkd. This prevents the multicast forwarder and the IPv6 provisioning code from being activated for such physical interfaces. This patch fixes adds "usb" as a possible name prefix for ethernet devices (as some other ethernet like configuration could appears with names like "usb%d") to solve the issue. Activating multicast forwarding and IPv6 for ARC when the upstream is cell is not expected to cause issues: IPv6 multicast forwarding: Not supported currently by arc-networkd. If it was, since pretty much all carriers assign full /64 unique prefixes to devices, the phone tethering routing will not forward the multicast packets to the upstream cellular networks. Only downstream tether clients of the phone could potentially receives packet from ARC or send multicast packets to ARC if the phone tethering routing would forward them. IPv4 multicast forwarding: The phone will only have a unique IPv4 address and is not expected to forward to the upstream cellular network multicast packets from any of its tether clients since necessarily a SNAT setup with a local IPv4 subnet for tether clients will be needed. IPv6 provisioning code: ARC will do SLAAC inside the /64 unique prefix assigned by the carrier which is expected to work. On IPv6 only cellular networks, Android phones already provision extra IPv6 addresses via SLAAC to implement 464 XLAT. When the feature flag ExoRawGamepadInfo is disabled, the test will fail. This CL creates a virtual gamepad device and injects events by using uinput. This CL tests the following features: * Gamepad connection/disconnection is properly notified by InputDeviceListener. * Gamepad buttons are properly mapped and notified as KeyEvent. The following part of the test will be added in upcoming CLs: * Gamepad axes are properly mapped an notified as MotionEvent. CRAS: dsp - Align dsp ini life cycle with dsp pipeline A dsp pipeline is constructed from a dsp ini structure that describes the topology. The pipeline structure has many member variables that points to the ini memory. Although these pointers to dsp ini is never used after constructing the pipeline, it's not good we free the ini while dsp pipeline is still alive. This change is for a crash that a NULL dsp ini being accessed, stack trace below. It avoids the NULL ini being accessed, and also makes the pointer value reasonable to avoid potential crash.
